description: Lint TSX/JSX against the design system. Reports hardcoded colors, spacing and radius (with the nearest token), native elements that have a design-system component, unknown components, props and variant values, and icon-only buttons without an accessible name. Each diagnostic has line/column, a rule id, a message and a suggested fix. Run it on every snippet or file you write and fix all errors. Pass `code` for unsaved code, or `path` for a file in the project.

code.description: TSX/JSX source to check (up to 1,000,000 characters).

filename.description: Name to report `code` under; a .jsx extension parses it as JSX. At a monorepo root, the path the code will be saved under, which picks the project whose design system checks it. When the server was started outside your project, pass it as an absolute path: the project is found from it.

limit.description: Most diagnostics to return, errors first (default 50). The counts and byRule cover all of them.

path.description: Path of a .tsx, .jsx, .ts or .js file to check: relative to the project root (the monorepo root, when served from there), or absolute.

name: check_ui

byRule.description: Every finding per rule, shown or not.

diagnostics.description: Up to `limit` diagnostics, errors first; `omitted` says how many more there are.

fix.description: Edits (0-based offsets into the checked code) that apply the suggestion.

notice.description: Set when no components or no color tokens were found, so rules did not run, when components came from modules the model does not include, when the project depends on a component library onsystem does not read yet, or when its dependencies are not installed.

ok.description: True when there are no errors.

skipped.description: Why the file was not checked: it renders an image (next/og) or an email, or the config's `exclude` leaves it out.

unchecked.description: Components imported from modules the model does not include, not checked.

title: Check UI code against the design system
